Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh have enforced the follow-on! History has been made. This is the first time ever they have done so. A thoroughly dominant show by their spinners. Mehidy Hasan roared with a 7-wicket haul while Shakib Al Hasan claimed a 3-fer. Apart from a fifty partnership between Dowrich and Hetmyer, there was no fight shown by Windies. Badly exposed. No technique. No skill. No temperament. No application. They lacked the main ingredients to succeed in Test cricket. No doubt it was challenging, it was supposed to be that way on this surface, but the tourists showed no stomach for a fight. They will get one more chance now, let's see how they fare against the spin trial this time around. Stay tuned.

OUT! Lewis is plumb in front! All over for Windies, shot out for 111! Shakib cleverly slips in an arm ball around off. Lewis has no idea about the variation. He gets forward in defense, looking out for the away spin but it skids through and hits him on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up immediately. Sherman takes the DRS, just for the formality. The Ball Tracker shows three reds. Done and dusted inside 37 overs.
Sherman Lewis is given out lbw this time. He has now referred it. Looks dead in front...

Safe! Height is indeed a factor. Shakib delivers it with a round-arm action and lets it land around middle and leg. It spins away a bit after hitting the surface and Sherman is squared up in defense. It raps him high on the back leg, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Bangladesh take the referral and the replays show that it's going over the stumps.
Shout for an lbw! Not given and Shakib takes the referral. Height factor?
Slower through the air, lands it full and outside off, Sherman pushes it towards point off the front foot.
Flatter and on off, Warrican goes back and punches it through wide mid on for a run.
Around off, well blocked by Lewis.
Best forward defense by a no. 11. Gets behind the ball and taps it to the off side.
Sherman Lewis is the number 11 batsman.

OUT! Dowrich goes and that's the last hope for Windies. Arm ball on off, it comes back into Dowrich who looks to work it away. Gets beaten as he played for the spin and the ball goes on to hit his back leg. Bangladesh put in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Dowrich without any doubt takes the review. Replays show us that it would be clipping the leg pole. So the on-field call stays. Windies retain their review but they would have wanted Dowrich more. A gritty innings from the keeper batsman comes to an end. 7 for Mehidy Hasan now!
Review! Have Bangladesh got their man? Dowrich has been given out LBW! Looks out too. Let's have a look.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Fuller ball outside off, Dowrich has driven it crisply through mid off. Naeem chases it, throws himself near the boundary line and saves a run for his side. They've managed to run three.
On middle, Shane taps it in front of him.
Around off, Jomel survives as he defends this off his back foot.
Keeps a bit low on off, Warrican drives it towards mid off.
Down the leg side, Dowrich gets low and swipes it through square leg to give Jomel the strike for the next two balls.
Similar ball on middle, drives it to the off side.
On middle, Shane plays it with a straight bat back to Shakib.
Around off, Dowrich stays back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Warrican punches it to mid off.
Fuller this time on middle, driven towards mid on to change strike.
FOUR! Short again on middle and leg, Dowrich goes deep inside and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. He has certainly looked solid out there.
On middle and leg, tapped towards the bowler.
Outside off, a lovely late delicate cut from Jomel towards deep backward point for three more runs.
Errs it down leg, Warrican tries to flick it away but gets it off his thigh pad fine to fine leg. They take two leg byes.
Misses his length as he dishes out a short ball down leg, Dowrich pulls it over mid-wicket for a brace.
Around off, Shane guides it towards cover-point.
This one bounces. Around off, curls away with extra bounce. Shane leaves it alone.
Similar ball and similar block by Dowrich.
In line of the stumps, this time Shane gets behind it and bunts it down.
Lovely! Tossed up ball on off, spins away from Dowrich who is ahead to block it.
Turning down the leg side, Warrican lets it go behind to the keeper.
Plays it with the spin and works it behind square leg for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, Shane is on the front foot and defends it.
Jomel Warrican is the new man in.

OUT! Roach holes out! Can't blame him. You don't expect a lot from a lower order batsman when your main batsmen have not shown any application and temperament. Mehidy bowls a loopy one on middle, Kemar tries to slog it across the line but gets a top edge. Liton Das settles underneath it at long on and takes the skier safely. Hasan gets his sixth, can he take 8 just like Yasir did a few days ago?
Skidding down, Dowrich turns it off his pads through square leg for one.
Flatter and a touch shorter on off, defended off the back foot.
Flighted on middle, swept behind square leg for a run.
Appeal for a catch! Not given. Turn and bounce for Shakib, Dowrich fails to defend and it probably goes off his body to first slip. A diving take there by the fielder but to no avail.

Shakib drops a sitter in his followthrough! Tossed up ball on middle, Roach chips it straight back to the bowler who lets it through his hands. It goes behind and they cross for a run. Shakib just cannot believe it.
Beaten! Too good for a number 9 batsman! Roach is forward to defend the line which is around off but is beaten by the away spin.
An arm ball on middle, Dowrich is on the front foot in defense but it takes the inside edge and rolls behind square leg for a run.
Too full and outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Roach works it down the leg side to square leg.
On leg stump, Roach looks to flick it but misses it completely to get hit low on his pads.
Kemar Roach is in next.

OUT! What a catch! It stuck but still it is a good catch! A bit on the shorter side outside off, Bishoo goes to cut it but checks his shot a bit at the last moment as the ball arrives late. Reaches for it eventually and then ends up giving it to Shadman Islam at silly point. The ball hits his chest and then the debutant manages to grab it. What a debut he is having! Also, this is the sixth fifer for Mehidy Hasan in Tests. The carnage continues in Mirpur.
Outside off, Bishoo tries to guide it past the slip fielder but cannot get it past him.
A tad short outside off, enough time for Dowrich to pull it through mid-wicket for a run.
Dowrich rocks back and taps this ball in front of himself.
Down leg, Bishoo tucks it away past short fine leg but his partner refuses the single. Maiden from Shakib.
On middle and leg, Bishoo stays back and taps it near the short leg fielder.
Beaten! Tossed up ball outside off, Bishoo is drawn forward to play it but cannot get bat to ball.
Darts this closer to the off pole, Bishoo is solid in his defense.
Loopy ball on off, driven to the off side.
On the leg stump, Bishoo plays it with a straight bat.
Fullish and on off, defended from the crease by Shane to end a successful over.
Tossed up ball on middle, turned off the pads to mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter on off, defended off the back foot.
Devendra Bishoo walks in next.

OUT! Forget the last ball, Hetmyer is gone this time. Mehidy has his man. First delivery was an off spinner which took the outside half of Hetmyer's bat. Then, it was a slider hitting the pads. And now again an off spinner which has dismissed Shimron. It's served in the line of the middle stump and spins away after landing. Hetmyer tries hitting it across the line through mid-wicket but doesn't account for the away spin. It catches the leading half of the bat and lobs back in the direction of the bowler. Mehidy immediately goes down low in his followthrough and catches it inches above the surface. Early blow for Windies. Follow-on looming large.

Vociferous appeal for an lbw, the umpire shakes his head. Shakib thinks of reviewing but is not convinced enough. A slider by the bowler, landing on middle and skidding down. Hetmyer fails to pick the variation, gets forward to defend and misses. He is thudded on the pads and they put in an unsuccessful appeal. Oh hello, the replays show that it's hitting the leg stump. Bangladesh have missed a trick there.
Mehidy serves an off spinner around middle and off, from 'round the wicket angle, Shimron gets forward and defends it from the outer half of the bat.
Flights this time and pitches it full in line of the stumps, Dowrich leans forward and defends it with a straight bat.
Quicker through the air, a low full toss, played towards mid-wicket.
The batsman pulls out at the last moment, maybe someone walked in front of the sightscreen.
FOUR! Good shot! No risk in that! Shakib drags his length short and bowls it around off. Shane pushes his weight on the back leg and punches it through point for a cracking boundary.
Much better this time. Dowrich draws forward to a full ball and defends it watchfully.

Just short of the point fielder! An uncalled shot, this. Shakib gives this one some extra air and bowls it full and outside off. Dowrich is tempted into the drive but ends up slicing it in the air. Mehidy puts in a dive but it falls in front.
Beaten first ball! Looking tentative, Shane. Tries to play the trajectory by lunging forward but is beaten by the away spin.
Given air over the stumps, Hetmyer blocks it out. Good comeback from Mehidy Hasan after going for the first ball six.
Tossed up ball around off, Shimron plays it with a straight bat.
On middle, this time he blocks it well.
Play and miss. A bit quicker outside off, Shimron looks to cut it but misses.
Loopy ball around off, Hetmyer taps it to the off side.

SIX! That's positive. First ball of Mehidy and he deposits it in the stands. Fuller ball in line of the stumps. Hetmyer gets under it and lofts it over long on for a biggie. Also, brings up the 50-run stand between these two. Need to carry along with the same intent.
Mehidy Hasan to bowl from the other end.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. Probably it has not skidded back in enough. An arm ball landing outside off, Dowrich decides to make a leave yet again but it skids through the surface and raps him on the back leg. Shakib appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Impact wasn't an issue there as Dowrich wasn't offering any shot but as mentioned earlier, the ball didn't change its direction enough to make connection with the stumps. The replays confirm the same.
Tossed up ball outside off, Dowrich makes a watchful leave.
Beaten! This will happen a lot today. Shakib tosses this one in the air and lands it closer to off stump. Shane tries to defend the line but it spins away to beat the bat.
This one is darted in by Shakib, full and on off, Dowrich brings down a straight bat in defense.
Turn and bounce. It lands around off and spins away sharply, Dowrich watches the line closely before making a leave.
Starts with a fuller length delivery in the line of the leg stump, Hetmyer flicks it in front of square leg and takes a run. It's important for Windies to stay positive and not get bogged down.
We are ready to get Day 3 underway. The Bangladeshi players have taken the field. Shimron Hetmyer and Shane Dowrich take the centre stage. Shakib Al Hasan will bowl the first over of the morning.

Mahmudullah doing an interview is pleased that most of the batters did well. Adds that he is happy to contribute for the team. On the balls outside off, he mentions that he is working on it and needs to be more careful. On batting lower down the order, he replies that he has the freedom to express himself.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo says that the pitch has dried up and there are a few spots outside the off stump for the right-handers. He reckons that the ball will misbehave if it lands there. Ends by giving an advice that using the feet should help the batsmen.

Just reminding you all that Windies are batting on the same 22-yards as were the hosts. They just had no answer to the spin bowling of the Tigers. In the span of 12 overs, the visitors lost half their side and are staring down the barrel now. However, Hetmyer and Dowrich looked good out there last evening. They did the rescue act in the first innings of the previous match and now have to do more than that to get their team back in the game. Bangladesh, meantime, will look to make early inroads yet again and then enforce the follow-on, something they have never done in the past. Will we see their spinners dictate terms or do the men from the Caribbean have it in them to stage a fightback? Do not go too far away. Action coming your way in a few minutes.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

The hosts have really planned this Test match superbly. Batted sensibly without taking any unnecessary risk on Day 1 and then capitalized on it on the following day. After all the hard work put in by the batsmen, their bowlers have now turned on the heat and it's all Bangladesh at the moment. Windies have their backs to the wall and need a miracle to turn things around. The current pair has shown application, let's see how they do on Sunday. Do join us at 0930 local (0330 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!

Earlier in the day, Bangladesh showed a lot of intent with the bat as they switched gears in the morning. Runs started to flow and they managed to form quite a few partnerships to reach 508. Mahmudullah stroked a patient century while the lower order also contributed to the cause. Windies' bowling was very dismal, mainly from their spinners as they failed to exploit the friendly conditions.

Yet another sorry batting performance by Windies. They were exposed badly by the spin pair of Shakib Al Hasan and Mehidy Hasan and lost half their side inside 12 overs. Their lack of skill and temperament was once again on display as the Bangladeshi spinners steamrolled them. All the five wickets were bowled which also shows the accuracy with which the Bangla tweakers bowled, something the Windies bowlers failed to achieve.
Spinning down the leg side, Dowrich tries flicking it but misses. That is it. STUMPS, DAY 2!
On off, some turn there, Dowrich jams it down.
Taken but off the pad that. Turn and bounce, Dowrich gets it off his thigh pad to the leg slip fielder.
Full and on legs, flicked away but straight to the man at square leg.
On middle and leg, turned to the on side.
Outside off, cut towards cover-point. One run added to the total.
In line of the stumps, Dowrich plants his foot forward and keeps it out. Good over from Mahmudullah.
Keeps low on middle, well watched by Dowrich who blocks it out.
Down the leg side, Shane tucks it around the corner for nothing.
Tosses this one up on off, Dowrich works it towards mid on.
Closer to the stumps, guided towards backward point.
Around off, defended off with a straight bat.
Mahmudullah is called on to bowl. Can he do it with the ball as well?
Shane has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Fuller ball on middle, milked away through mid-wicket for a brace.
SH has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! This is how he plays! Puts on his dancing shoes and lofts this over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Long appeal but nothing from the umpire. Loopy ball on off, Hetmyer looks to keep it out but gets struck on his pads. They appeal but the impact of that was outside off. No reason to take it up.
Tad short outside off, Hetmyer rocks back and slaps it through mid off for a couple of runs.
Taijul Islam to bowl his first over.
Good cricket. A boundary followed by a run. Taps this towards square leg and sets off for a run to keep strike for the next over.
FOUR! Even though it is turning a bit, Hetmyer gets close to the ball and lofts this over mid-wicket for a boundary. Calculated risk.
Tossed up on off, carves but straight to the man point.
On off, Hetmyer comes down to drive it to the off side.
On middle, spinning into Hetmyer who misses his shot to get hit on his pads. Drifting down the leg that.
Outside off, nicely cut away through backward point for a couple. This partnership is now worth 30.
Extra bounce from a fuller length around off, Dowrich goes inside the crease and does well to defend it with soft hands.
Uses his wrists and flicks it off his pads through mid-wicket for a run.
Full again, knocked down to long on for one.
Fullish and outside off, Shane drives it through extra cover for a couple.
Skidding back into the batsman, Hetmyer hangs a straight bat and it takes the inside half of it. Rolls in the gap on the leg side and they cross.
FOUR! Hasan delivers a short ball outside off, staying low, Hetmyer does well to keep his eyes on the ball as he moves back to pull it powerfully to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Straighter in line, forced down to long on for one.
Hetmyer dances down the track and tries to flick. But it comes off the leading edge and nearly carries back to the bowler.
Quicker and on off, defended off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Missing the stumps! Slower through the air by Naeem as he lands it full on middle. The ball spins away after landing as Hetmyer fails to block it with a straight bat. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the umpire agrees. Shimron takes the DRS and the Ball Tracker shows that it's spinning way too much. Hetmyer survives.
Appeal for an lbw! The finger has gone up. Shimron Hetmyer has opted for the DRS. Spinning too much?
Fires this one in, full and on middle, Shimron tries to flick but gets a little leading edge back to the bowler.
Starts with a short delivery outside off, Hetmyer cuts it from the back foot but fails to beat point. The fielder makes a tumbling stop.
Bowling change. Naeem Hasan introduced into the attack.
Loopy off spinner on middle, Dowrich plays it off his pads, soft hands, and it rolls to leg gully.
Tickles it with the spin to mid-wicket where the fielder makes a diving stop.
Flatter and in the line of the stumps, staying low again, Dowrich is inside the crease in defense.
Turning back into the batsman from around middle, Dowrich works it in front of square leg.
Flighted on middle, played towards short leg.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot! Dowrich uses his feet to come down the track, reaches the pitch of the delivery in a flash and smashes it over mid on. This shot will give a lot of confidence to Shane.
Beaten! Short and outside off, staying low, Hetmyer tries to cut but misses.
Loopy ball on middle, it's swept behind square leg for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another front foot defense offered by Shane.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.

Appeal! Shakib delivers a full ball around off, it skids through, Dowrich is forward in defense but it takes the inside edge and goes past the stumps to fine leg for a couple. Shakib turns to appeal, thinking it has hit the pads and slips in the process. Gets up and smiles.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Squares him up. On middle and leg, Dowrich looks to work it to the on side but closes the bat face early. Gets a leading edge to the off side. Not carrying to the cover fielder.
Uppish but safe. Hetmyer lofts this over wide mid on. The ball does not go all the way as the fielder chases this and saves a run for his side.
On middle and leg, turned around the corner for a run.
Dowrich flicks it away with a wristy shot to short leg.
Quick single but they make it. On middle and leg, Dowrich plays it towards mid-wicket and hares to the other end.
In the air...but safe. A shot in frustration there. Loopy ball on leg, Hetmyer looks to go big. Doesn't get under it entirely. To his good luck, it falls short of the long on fielder. They cross.
Similar line, Shimron works it around the corner to mid-wicket.
A tad short down leg, Hetmyer rocks back and plays it to the square leg fielder.
Slower ball on the legs, tapped ahead of the short leg fielder.
Darts this around off, Hetmyer guides it towards short covers.
Outside off, Hetmyer drives it past point to retain strike for the next over.
Outside off, played to point.
Beaten! Crazy! Some keep low, some bounce extra! Really a testing surface. Around off, Hetmyer looks to drive this but it spins big time to beat his bat. A very good take from the keeper behind.
Goes back to this one and punches the ball to the off side.
Full and on middle and leg, Hetmyer gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Outside off, driven to covers.
Loopy ball in line of the stumps, Dowrich gets low and taps this in front of himself.
Down the leg side, turned away against the spin for one.
Loopy ball on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Better. Dowrich gets behind this one and keeps it out.
What a way to welcome Dowrich to the crease! Gives this air on off, spins away from the keeper-batsman who gets low to block it but gets beaten.
Full on leg, hit away from the mid on fielder for a run.
Shane Dowrich is in next at number 7.

OUT! Tell you what, Windies have lost half their side inside 12 overs. Boy oh boy! What an exhibition of spin bowling! Tossed up ball around off, Hope rocks back to play at this. To his dismay, the ball keeps really low. He tries getting his bat down but it's too late. The ball goes under his bat and meets the stumps. Nothing much you can do as a batsman. Windies in real trouble. Half the side back in the hut, all the batsmen bowled, this must be some kind of a record.
On off, hit uppishly towards the bowler to mid off. They cross.
On middle and leg, turned through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! That looked good. Flighted ball outside off, Hope leans ahead and drives this crisply through covers for a boundary.
Shows the full face of the bat and blocks this one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Arm ball on leg, goes away from Shimron down the leg side who covers his stumps and decides against playing it.
Arm ball on middle and leg, stays a shade low. Hetmyer keeps it out with a straight bat.
Short and outside off, Hetmyer cuts it to deep point for an easy couple.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Sharp and big turn down leg. Hope tries to flick it away but the ball touches his leg and rolls towards square leg where they take a leg bye.
Arm ball outside off, cut to point.
Full and on off, driven to the mid off fielder.
Down the leg side, Hetmyer looks to swipe to that one but gets hit outside leg on his pad.
Lovely! Spins into Hetmyer from outside off who does well to keep it out.
Shimron Hetmyer to face the music now.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Four down now are the Windies and one of the better players of spin in their team walks back without opening his account. Another batsman playing for the turn loses his timber. Hasan floats this one on off, the ball doesn't spin back in much and that brings Roston's downfall. He has his bat closer to the front pad in anticipation but the ball never arrives. Instead, it takes a route which beats the outside edge of his bat and shatters the stumps. 4 wickets for Bangladesh, two apiece for the spinners and all bowled.
Played to mid-wicket region by Hope. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Down leg side, Hope helps it through deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Roston Chase is the new batsman with Windies in huge trouble.

OUT! 3 in 3. All falling to spinners. Shakib leading the way. The idea was right from Ambris but not the execution as he got fooled by the variation. Shakib flights this on off, Sunil comes down the track and looks to go big over covers. Plays for the turn but the ball doesn't spin. Goes straight and hits the stumps at the back. Bangladesh all over the Windies. How many can they pick up today?
Errs this down leg, Ambris covers his stumps and lets it go.
Flatter ball outside off, cute late cut by Sunil to backward point.
Gives this air outside off, bunted down before silly point.
On leg, played with a straight bat.
Tossed up on middle, Ambris gives room and goes for the big slog. Gets it off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket for an easy brace.
Full and on middle and leg, hit to mid on. Dot ball.
Gets behind this ball and keeps it out in front of himself.
Four byes! Arm ball on middle, it spins across from Hope down the leg side. The keeper fails to collect it and the ball trickles down to the fine leg fence.
Played through mid-wicket by SA. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! The first boundary for the Windies. The confidence on this was lovely. Not afraid to use his feet and gets a boundary to his name. Tossed up on off, Ambris comes ahead and creams it through covers for a boundary.
A bit flat on middle and leg, turned away to the on side.
Flighted and full outside off, Hope covers his stumps and allows it through.
Walks down the track to a full ball and drives it to extra cover.
Flat again, skidding in from a shorter length outside off, Hope moves back inside the crease in defense.
Drags his length short and bowls it on off, Hope punches it straight to covers.
A stifled appeal but there is inside edge. Arm ball on off, skidding through, Shai is forward in defense but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full and on middle, bowled with a round-arm action, Hope defends it by getting forward.
Gives this air on off, driven to mid off.
On the leg side, flicked away to square leg.
Played through mid-wicket by Ambris.
Sunil Ambris' turn to give the spin test.

OUT! Bowled 'em! This time it is Mehidy Hasan! Bangladesh are on a roll. Arm ball landing on off and it keeps a bit low. A similar mistake like Kraigg as Kieran too leaves some space between bat and pad. The ball goes through the gap and onto the stumps as Powell tries to push it to the off side. The stumps are broken and Mehidy joins the party. Remember, Powell had hit twin centuries in a Test match in Mirpur. Bangladesh will be more than happy to see his back.
Down leg, Powell looks to flick it but misses to get hit on his pads.
Straighter one outside off, Powell leaves it alone.
On middle and leg, turned away to the on side. Dot ball.
On the pads, flicked away through square leg to rotate strike.
Full on off, driven towards mid of to change strike.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Darts this quick on off, Powell once again stays back and does well then to get bat to ball. He gets an educated edge towards third man for a run.
Errs down leg, Powell helps it to short fine leg.
Down the leg side, Powell flicks it to the cow corner region for just one.
On off again, played back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Gives this a loop outside off, Powell who should be coming forward stays back and almost gets the outside edge.
Loopy ball on off, kept out by Powell.
Outside off, Powell rocks back but punches it to the cover-point fielder.
On off, played with a straight bat.
On middle and leg, punched back to the bowler. Nicely played by Hope but suddenly the pitch looks different.
Full on off, driven to covers.
On middle and off, Hope goes back onto his back foot and taps it in front of him.
On off, bunted back to the silly point fielder.
Another one which comes back in. Shai covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
Tossed this one full on off, Hope blocks it out.
Spinning away from the batsman, Powell drives it through the line towards covers.
Gives this one air and bowls it outside off, Powell leaves.
Uses his feet a bit this time and nudges it in the direction of mid on for a run. Shai is off the mark as well.
Loopy again, landing full around off, Shai draws forward in defense.
Tossed up delivery, an off spinner on the shorter side, Hope goes on the back foot and taps it down in front of short leg.
Fuller in length and outside off, Powell drives it through extra cover and gets off the mark with a single.
Shai Hope is in at no. 3. Also, Mehidy Hasan to bowl from the other end.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Shakib Al Hasan, you beauty! Was good with the bat and now even better with the ball. Gets the previous one to spin away and this one skids back in. Arm ball around off, Brathwaite doesn't read it and comes forward to drive it through the line. Leaves a big gap between bat and pad and the ball sneaks through to destroy the stumps. Shakib gets the better of his counterpart and Bangladesh are roaring, already!
Spins away from Kraigg who gets behind it and keeps it out.
Full on middle, driven to mid on.
Straighter one outside off, left alone.
Full this time on middle, blocked out.
Tossed up ball on off, Brathwaite leans forward to block it but gets beaten. What turn on that one. Perhaps needs a second slip.
